title: Saturday Quick Tip
subtitle: The first words after a mistake
hook: A grounder rolls through. Everyone is watching you.
intro: The ball rolls right past your player's glove.
They look straight at the dugout.
statement: Your next words decide how they play the next pitch.
q1: Do you say something quick and encouraging —
q2: or say nothing and let them reset?
q3: What does that player need from you right now?
t1: Both can work. But players recover faster
cta: Coaches — what do you say after a mistake?
ctaLines: Next pitch. Shake it off. A thumbs up.
ctaPrompt: Share your dugout habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A grounder rolls through. Everyone is watching you.
The ball rolls right past your player's glove. They look straight at the dugout.
Your next words decide how they play the next pitch.
A quick word or quiet space. There is no single right way.
What do you say after a mistake? Share your habit in the comments.
